stemBlocks: When organic compounds are treated with an alkaline aqueous solution of iodine, a yellow precipitate is formed by those compounds that contain either of these structural fragments: $H_3C-C(=O)-\text{{~~}}$ or $H_3C-CH(OH)-\text{{~~}}$. There are 8 structurally isomeric alcohols with the molecular formula $C_5H_{12}O$. Each of these alcohols was heated under reflux with excess acidified potassium dichromate(VI).
How many of these alcohols gave a product that would form a yellow precipitate with an alkaline aqueous solution of iodine?
